notes: Anarthrous υἱός takes the supplied *the* as a rule 51 helper, while τοῦ before θεοῦ is unrepresented under rule 23 because the ASV writes *of God* with no determiner, the case preposition staying on the noun.
τῷ before λίθῳ is emptied by the demonstrative τούτῳ under rule 38, and ἵνα takes the *that* introducing its English clause under rule 40.
